reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text: Water added via Apple Watch doesn’t add to total. Watch and phone app always out of sync.  Please fix

I used to use this app consistently and I really loved it then. It would remind me to drink more water and I could document the various drinks I would consume. The app updated a few months ago and I have since stopped using it, you now have to pay for drinks other than water.

reviews.title: 会员太贵了
reviews.text: 几乎所有功能需要会员，会员特别贵

reviews.title: Another Bogus Charge
reviews.text: The pro app on my phone locked and told me I have to pay again for the pro version. Silly me. I tried again to get the pro version and it charged me, but still wouldn't let me in. This is the second time I've had similar issues. Nice app ... when not ripping us off.

reviews.title: Purchased
reviews.text: I subscribed to the yearly rate and am still unable to get the subscription features it is supposed to offer.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: This morning the app was working fine, then this afternoon I logged in and caffeine tracking and other features are unlocked unless I upgrade to Pro with a lifetime subscription. Then I get a message saying there is no in-app purchase info. Now I can’t use the app except for basic water tracking and I think my card has been charged multiple times but I have a free trial. A mess. I’ve used the app for years but now I might have to switch. I want my money back!

reviews.title: Greed strikes again
reviews.text: Free features (a specific one I used was custom drinks) are now locked behind a pay wall. Deleted & won’t be using again.

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: I purchased a lifetime subscription years ago and it suddenly stopped working now everything is locked again. I literally PAID FOR THIS. Just use Chronometer or MyFitnessPal at this point.

reviews.title: Update locked 80% of the selections
reviews.text: Once upon a time 80% of the sections were free to use. Things like soda and mundane things like herbal tea is now locked behind a paywall. You could also type in your own reminders; again behind a paywall. Capitalism strikes again. If I could give it zero stars I would.

reviews.title: Update broke app
reviews.text: None of my customized drinks appear. Latest update broke the app. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Update = DOWNGRADE
reviews.text:
Check the dates of the reviews. That will tell you when this app started going downhill. 

UPDATE: The greed continues! Now any liquid other than water requires payment. Any positive stars for this app are from when it had functionality that wasn’t blocked by a pay wall. What an unethical bait and switch. 

––

Seriously?! How greedy! You can’t take features away with an upgrade, hide them behind a paywall and think your users will be happy about it. 

I use this app daily, for almost a year, to motivate me to hydrate— not because it’s “fun” but to help me from getting kidney stones. Every now and then I need to go back and add an entry for water missed the day before. NOW, I need to pay for that?!

Looks like I may be downgrading to the previous version or use another free app. C’mon guys, this isn’t a good look for you

reviews.title: WHAT IS UP W THE NEW UPDATE??? VERY GREEDY PEOPLE
reviews.text:
I was enjoying this app, putting all the water ANDDDD other recording drink options, and also, putting water records for the days that I missed. The app was perfect before, UNTIL THEY DECIDED TWO LOCK THOSE FEATURES THAT MADE ME KEEP THIS APP IN THE FIRST PLACE!! 

Uninstalled :(

reviews.title: Very sneaky
reviews.text: Taking away features and locking them behind a paywall is a bad look. I can’t even input drinks from previous days anymore? Will be looking at other apps that will track what is behind a paywall for less.

reviews.title: Yet another good app turned greedy
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for months to meet my water intake for my fitness goals. I liked this one specifically because I could track other beverages and it would log the water that it contains for me. NOW, all the sudden, they lock every drink but water, coffee, milk, and tea behind a paywall. Who the hell is paying for a water tracker? Not every app needs a subscription!

So yeah, I uninstalled. I’ll go find another water tracker that isn’t forcing microtransactions on me. Being healthy should not be gatekept through money and it’s awful morals to operate a business on.

reviews.title: Paywall blocks too much
reviews.text: Used this app for 3 years because of its unique function of tracking other than water without paying. Not anymore! No chance im paying £18 for something ive done for free for the last 3 years.

reviews.title: Great until the recent update
reviews.text: It was a brilliant app, to log all the different fluids you had a day for free. But then to block even more and ask for £17.99 one off just to get access to all?? Nope sorry that’s taking the Micky. Bye bye

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: App used to be 5 stars, but an update forces the Apple Watch widget to only display units in milliliters even though all of my settings are in ounces. Several updates have come and gone and still haven’t fixed this issue.

reviews.title: CRASHING ALL THE TIME
reviews.text: It’s a shame bc I love this app so much. I’ve really personalised using the premium subscription and it is genuinely my favourite app in the whole world. BUT IT KEEPS CRASHING. Please fix this bug bc it’s so annoying😭 When I try and log what I drink, it crashes and I can’t update and it’s so irritating. If this isn’t sorted, I’m gonna ask for my money back and explore alternative apps but I really don’t want to because I REALLY LOVE THIS APP SO SO SO MUCH!!!

reviews.title: Lots of bugs lately
reviews.text: Used to be good…but lots of bugs…very annoying
